name: Kurt Opsahl
description:
Kurt Opsahl has worked on technology law and policy for close to 30 years. He has helped shape the law on fair use, free expression, and online privacy, and helped establish and defend the principle that code is speech. He has long supported privacy-enhancing technologies, security researchers, open-source projects, and the decentralized web.

Kurt is Of Counsel to Ridder, Costa & Johnstone, a boutique technology law firm. From 2004 to 2023, he was Deputy Executive Director and General Counsel of the Electronic Frontier Foundation, and he continues to assist EFF as a volunteer Special Counsel. After EFF, he served as Associate General Counsel and then General Counsel of the Filecoin Foundation. He is President of the Board of both the Security Research Legal Defense Fund and the Financial Privacy Foundation, and a member of the OpenArchive Advisory Board and the Zcash Community Advisory Panel.
